Files the site serves as plain links, so they can be opened or downloaded straight from a phone.

`RoomCheck-<version>.apk` — the current Android build. Only ever one of them: a new build replaces
it rather than piling up beside it, because an APK is eleven megabytes and git keeps every copy it
is ever given, forever.

`latest.json` — which build that is, its size and its SHA-256. The app reads it to see whether a
newer build is out, and checks the download against it before installing. Written with the APK by
`gradle :app:publishApk`, never by hand.

`beds.png` — every room's beds on one page. Generated by `tools/plan-poster.py` from Roster.kt, so
re-run that after moving a bed rather than editing the picture.

`mark-sheet.png` — the same plans in Hebrew, with an empty circle beside every name, for marking a
round without the app or the site: send the picture, tick or cross each circle, send it back.
Generated by `tools/mark-sheet.py`, which draws through plan-poster.py's code.
